case_analysis.thread_summary: The thread concerns preparation for a customer meeting about Bluetooth qualification registration and Japanese radio certification requirements. The customer submitted a pre-meeting Bluetooth certification QA sheet and later added questions related to TELEC and radio law certification. Internal discussion focused on correcting meeting communication details and preparing technically accurate customer responses before the meeting. The consultant also provided internal business guidance regarding the low profitability and high support burden associated with handling TELEC certification projects for inexperienced customers.
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The discussion covered both Bluetooth SIG qualification registration and Japanese radio certification (技適 / TELEC) support expectations. The consultant emphasized the importance of reviewing and answering customer qualification questions in advance of the meeting. Internal guidance highlighted that customers unfamiliar with radio certification terminology often require significantly more support effort than standard Bluetooth logo qualification projects. The thread also reflects coordination between sales and technical consulting teams to prepare consolidated answers before customer discussions.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: The consultant's reasoning was that proactive clarification and pre-review of customer qualification questions would improve meeting efficiency and reduce confusion during technical discussions. Internally, the consultant also assessed the support burden versus business value of handling TELEC certification requests, recognizing that inexperienced customers typically require extensive explanation and operational support beyond normal Bluetooth qualification consulting.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: If Bluetooth qualification and TELEC certification discussions are not clarified early, the customer may misunderstand the scope, complexity, or responsibilities associated with certification activities. Poor preparation or inaccurate communication could lead to project delays, excessive support overhead, repeated clarification cycles, or underestimation of engineering and consulting effort required for radio certification support.
case_analysis.consulting_mistake: An incorrect meeting reference was initially sent to the customer stating that the discussion would occur 'tomorrow' instead of the correct scheduled date two days later. The mistake was identified internally and corrected in the follow-up customer communication before the meeting occurred.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: For Bluetooth qualification consulting projects that also involve regional radio certifications such as TELEC, consultants should align customer expectations early, review technical questions before meetings, and evaluate whether the support burden matches the project value and available consulting resources.
